visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black-rimmed glasses and a beige t-shirt stands indoors, speaking to the camera. He smiles and makes a peace sign with his hand. In the background, a white shelf with a green plant and a white pet playpen are visible. (2) The scene cuts to a small black and tan puppy sitting inside a white wire playpen on a mat decorated with bone and paw prints. A grey and white plastic pet carrier sits behind the puppy. (3) The man's hands enter the frame, guiding the puppy through various tricks including sitting and lying down. The puppy responds slowly, and the man rewards it with small treats. (4) The man demonstrates more advanced tricks like 'playing dead' (bang) and shaking hands. The puppy follows the hand gestures, and the man praises it with head rubs. (5) In the final segment, the man places several kibbles on the mat and tells the puppy to wait. The puppy sits still with its tongue slightly out. Finally, the man allows the puppy to eat from his palm.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young man speaks enthusiastically in Mandarin over a bright, plucky acoustic guitar BGM with a steady 4/4 beat. He introduces his new puppy. (2) The vocal delivery becomes directive as he gives commands like 'Sit' and 'Pa'. Cartoonish 'pop' sound effects accentuate the puppy's successful movements. (3) The man offers verbal praise and rewards. There's a metallic 'ting' sound effect when the puppy performs a trick correctly. The BGM remains light and cheerful. (4) The speech density increases as the man describes the dog's delayed reactions. The guitar rhythm continues consistently. (5) In the final phase, the man lowers his volume slightly to command 'Don't touch', followed by high-pitched encouraging phrases when the puppy succeeds, ending with the sound of kibble being eaten.
